title: Community Movie Night
location: Riverdale Community Center, 2nd floor or online via Zoom
details: Join us for a free movie night designed to bring people together! Whether you’re joining in person or online, it’s a great chance to socialize and make new friends. Popcorn will be provided on-site, and an interactive chat room will be available for virtual attendees.
howToJoin: contact Karan at Karankmj05@gmail.com.com for more info.

title: Potluck & Story Sharing Evening
location: Kensington Market Community Centre, 99 Baldwin St, Toronto
details: Bring a dish to share and join us for a night of food and storytelling. Everyone is invited to share personal stories, experiences, or just listen. The event is aimed at connecting people from diverse backgrounds and creating a warm, supportive atmosphere.
howToJoin: Sign up creativityishere.com or contact PatelAditya@gmail.com for more information.

title: Walking Group – Discover Toronto’s Parks
location: Meet at the entrance to Trinity Bellwoods Park, Queen St W & Strachan Ave, Toronto
details: Join us for a relaxing walk through Toronto’s beautiful parks. The group is open to all, and it’s a great opportunity to meet new people, stay active, and explore the city. The walk will end with coffee and snacks at a local café.
howToJoin: No registration needed, just show up! For questions, email Dhrumil.com.

title: Community Yoga in the Park
location: Kew Gardens, 2075 Queen St E, Toronto
details: Join us for a free, inclusive yoga session in Kew Gardens! Open to all fitness levels, this event is aimed at bringing people together in a peaceful outdoor setting. Yoga mats will be provided, and all are welcome to stay afterward for tea and a casual chat with fellow participants.
howToJoin: No registration needed, just show up! For inquiries, email yogaincommunitytoronto@gmail.com.

title: Art Therapy Workshop
location: Artscape Daniels Launchpad, 130 Queens Quay E, Toronto
details: This art therapy workshop is open to everyone looking to express themselves creatively in a supportive group environment. No artistic skills are required! The event is designed to help reduce stress, anxiety, and social isolation by fostering creativity and connection.
howToJoin: Register creativityishere.com  or email workshops@artstherapyto.ca for more details.

title: Multicultural Food Festival
location: Nathan Phillips Square, 100 Queen St W, Toronto
details: Celebrate diversity through food! Join us for a fun afternoon of tasting dishes from around the world, made by local community members. This event aims to bring together people from different cultures and backgrounds to connect over shared meals and stories. Vegetarian and vegan options will be available.
howToJoin: Entry is free, but you can pre-register foodfest.com to get event updates.

title: Cultural Dance Workshop
location: Harbourfront Centre, 235 Queens Quay W, Toronto
details: Learn traditional dances from various cultures at this inclusive and fun workshop! Whether you’re a beginner or experienced, this event is open to all and encourages community bonding through movement and music.

title: Mindfulness & Meditation for Connection
location: Toronto Mindfulness Centre, 55 Dundas St W, Toronto
details: Join us for a guided meditation session focusing on mindfulness and connection. This event is designed to help reduce stress, encourage self-reflection, and foster a sense of belonging through group meditation. Suitable for all levels.
